ModMetaData.name: TakeCover Tweak
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial control tweak for TakeCover.
Plain right-drag with drafted pawns issues a take-cover order: - The cell where you press is the rally point the formation is centered on. - The drag direction is the enemy direction; cover is chosen against it. - The drag length is the total formation width. - Pawns spread out in a single row, stepping at most 2 cells forward or back to reach cover. Pawns that find no cover still take their place in the row.
While dragging, each destination circle shows its cover against the enemy direction: green 50% or more, yellow 20% or more, red below 20%.
A right-click without dragging, or any right-click while holding Ctrl, behaves like vanilla.
Shift + scroll width adjustment and the drag line are removed.
Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
A note to rabiosus, the author of TakeCover: sorry for changing how your mod works. I really like TakeCover, and the cover search behind every order here is still yours. I just really wanted a Company of Heroes-like way to command squads, and building on your mod was the best way I found to get there. If you would rather this tweak not be shared, please let me know.
